description: Automatic compaction at the context limit, answered by Fluid through the mod's session.compact hook (the mod's rows replace the conversation; Claude Code's own summarizer never runs).
evidence: Claude Code 2.1.312 bundle (read, never run): the hook replaces the core compaction, so the callback that prints status 'compacting' and runs PreCompact never runs; the post-compact step runs SessionStart(compact), then status null + compact_result success is queued, then the query loop yields [boundary, ...replacement].
